mapper.select: select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName from SYS_ORG
select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName,DIRECTOR_ID as directorId from SYS_ORG where ID = #{orgId}
select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName,DIRECTOR_ID as directorId from SYS_ORG where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and NAME = #{orgName}

SELECT id AS orgId, NAME AS orgName, PARENT_ID AS parentId, DIRECTOR_ID AS directorId FROM SYS_ORG WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND CATEGORY = 'DEPT' AND PARENT_ID COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci IN ( SELECT ID FROM SYS_ORG WHERE PARENT_ID COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci IN ( SELECT ID FROM SYS_ORG WHERE PARENT_ID = '0' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) )
